blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Manila Water is strengthening its El Niño preparedness by maximizing its six active water treatment plants, which have a combined capacity of 1,980 million liters per day (MLD), and advancing two more major water treatment facilities that will further boost 24/7 service for customers in Metro Manila and Rizal. Under the Angat-Ipo-La Mesa system are the 470-MLD Balara Filter 1, the 1,130-MLD Balara Filter 2, and the 150-MLD East La Mesa Water Treatment Plant, with a combined capacity of 1,750 MLD.
